rows.quote: Genome-wide association study summary data used in this study are available publicly from the GWAS catalog (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/) and FinnGen round 10 (https://www.finngen.fi).The eQTL, and mQTL, sQTL for SMR analysis are available publicly from The Yang Lab platform, Westlake University, China (https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/smr/#Download).
rows.coder_note: "FinnGen round 10" names release 10 (rule A). The methods sentence writes "FinnGen Release 1024", which is Release 10 followed by citation 24, and agrees.

rows.quote: Independence was determined using the OpenGWAS Database API within the ieugwasr R package by excluding linkage disequilibrium (LD) (r2 < 0.001, clumping window > 10,000 kb).26–28 Glaucoma and subtypes (POAG and PACG) data were cross-referenced from FinnGen Release 1024 and the Million Veteran Program.29 The GWAS summary statistics for IOP metrics,30 retinal imaging biomarkers,30 gut microbiota,31 inflammatory factors,32 and lipidome,33 were obtained from the GWAS catalog.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the Million Veteran Program glaucoma GWAS (citation 29, Verma 2024) as an outcome source; the dictionary has no Million Veteran Program row, and its FinnGen R12 + MVP + UK Biobank meta-analysis row is a different dataset.

The pQTL statistics are attributed to "the GWAS of the UKB-PPP" with one grouped citation 20-22 (Eldjarn 2023, an unlinked entry 21, Dhindsa 2023), which maps to several sources (rule F); no sentence gives a subcohort, ancestry or exact N to separate the UKB-PPP rows, and "more than 50,000 individuals" is approximate.
